hook: Anna and Ben talk about going to the gym.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: I go to the gym after work.

translation.vi: Tôi đi tập gym sau giờ làm.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Before I go, I drink water.

translation.vi: Trước khi đi, tôi uống nước.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: After I go, my body feels great.

translation.vi: Sau khi đi, cơ thể tôi cảm thấy rất khỏe.

gloss.en: a place with machines for exercise

grammar_notes: Use 'before' or 'after' with a subject and verb to say when something happens: 'Before I go, I drink water.'
interaction_prompts: What do you do before or after you exercise?
